name: Ayauta (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ayauta town emblem in white: a stylised letter C-shaped device with a hooked stroke.
history: Flag of the former town of Ayauta in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1973.

features.role: Ayauta town emblem — a stylised letter C-shaped device with a hooked stroke
